Find the smallest factorial you know, then let each bigger helper ask the next smaller one.

Replace your code with the answer?
The factorial workshop Goal: discover 4!
Ready to follow factorial(4) Each helper asks one smaller helper, then waits for the answer.
Ready
Why multiply? 4! means 4 × 3 × 2 × 1. The smaller helper already works out 3 × 2 × 1, so this helper only needs to multiply that answer by 4.
Step complete Continue when the flow makes sense.
Programmer words for what you just watched: the waiting helpers form a call stack. Answers travelling back up are called unwinding.

Press “Play the helper chain” to hear the idea first, then watch questions travel down and answers travel back up.
